correctness.rationale: Causal stability for all positive coefficients gives a unique stationary solution. The stationary generator equations fix E[X sigma], E[V sigma], C(0), and C'(0), independently reproducing the exact forced second-order ODE and its three-mode solution. In the nonoscillatory regime, positive mechanical impulse response convolved against a positive exponential driving covariance is strictly positive. In the underdamped regime, the exact ratio R/A is <1 at the switching boundary. On its slow side, an exhaustive sine-coefficient dichotomy yields either an explicit strictly negative decreasing amplitude polynomial or a sharp exponential/trigonometric envelope inequality. On its fast side, the slowest nonzero mode oscillates indefinitely, forcing infinitely many alternating signs. The first-zero bracket is of width one mechanical period, and smooth expansion gives the explicit O(1) asymptotic remainder. The signed area equals the matched zero-frequency transfer spectral density. Numerical tests independently verify finite examples only.

originality.rationale: The assessed novelty is the strict all-lag sign classification, the exact flip-rate threshold, and the singular first-zero boundary coefficient for the physically motivated inertial velocity-jump trap; not the model, its stationary variance, its mechanical poles, a colored-force covariance formula, or standard filtering. Dutta et al. (arXiv:2406.06120v1) analyze stationary one-time statistics and nonstationary moments; Nguyen et al. (arXiv:2108.14005v1) develop the covariance-equivalent Gaussian colored-noise harmonic oscillator and its MSD, so formula-level deductions are partly covered. Neither relevant inspected source states or classifies the global strict positivity of stationary two-time *position* autocovariance for all parameter values or its sharp first-zero blow-up. Overdamped RTP correlation work cannot imply the underdamped oscillatory transition without the added inertia. Broader older spectral-response literature could nevertheless contain a mathematically equivalent theorem and remains a priority risk.
residual_risks: An older general second-order stationary covariance theorem for exponentially correlated colored forcing could imply exactly the same universal positivity threshold and delay coefficient in a different notation.
Gaussian forcing with matched exponential autocovariance gives the same two-time covariance, so the covariance formula itself has strong prior-method coverage and is expressly not claimed as new.
The 2022 Smith–Farago source was not read in complete full text; its abstract alone cannot support a definitive noncoverage judgment.
Independent expert priority and correctness audit has not yet occurred.

value.rationale: A natural physical memory observable—the lag at which stationary positions first become anticorrelated—is not determined by the known single-time distributions. The theorem gives the complete qualitative phase diagram, shows that underdamping alone is insufficient for negative-lag memory, proves positivity on the critical boundary despite complex response poles, and exhibits a singular parameter-controlled onset with a precise coefficient. Its integrated covariance is simultaneously independent of inertia and friction, explaining why global signed area hides oscillatory negative-lag behavior. This is a structural all-parameter classification, not a routine substitution or arbitrary numerical parameter slice.
